description: This Java source file defines the AliasKeyManager class, which implements the X509KeyManager interface to handle SSL key management with the ability to specify a particular certificate alias for client authentication. It provides methods to select client and server aliases, retrieve certificate chains, and access private keys, primarily customizing the alias selection process.

classes.name: AliasKeyManager
classes.description: A KeyManager implementation that wraps an existing X509KeyManager to allow specifying a specific certificate alias for SSL client authentication.

methods.name: chooseClientAlias
methods.description: Selects a client alias matching the specified key types and the configured alias.

methods.name: chooseServerAlias
methods.description: Delegates server alias selection to the wrapped key manager.

methods.name: getCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for the specified alias.

methods.name: getClientAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of client aliases for the specified key type and issuers.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the private key associated with the specified alias.

methods.name: getServerAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of server aliases for the specified key type and issuers.
